name: TAPEDELAY2
author: amnmkkr
description: Airwindows' TapeDelay2 (Chris Johnson, MIT) as a send effect: a tape loop whose speed sets the time, so a TIME change bends the pitch of the repeats, with a band-pass in the feedback whose resonance is the SMEAR knob, and a gentle fixed flutter. TIME is free or synced to the Rytm's tempo.
